neighbours.label: public-provision context where 'resources / services / support' is expected next: institutions obliged to provide, or having fewer/less of, them (peaks on the function word or quantifier just before)
fire: Under federal law, public schools must supply every blind student with braille materials and trained aides.
Children in the poorest neighborhoods attend schools that have fewer counselors and less classroom support.
The clinic is legally responsible to offer low-income mothers prenatal care and nutrition advice.
Small libraries are trying to stretch shrinking budgets over demands for ever-expanding services.
Many rural districts simply have less funding and fewer support staff than suburban ones.
The state is required to furnish each foster child with health coverage and counselling.
Underfunded colleges that enroll the neediest students tend to have fewer financial resources.
By statute, the county must give elderly residents access to transport and home care.
quiet: Public schools in the district open at eight and close at three every weekday.
Children in the poorest neighborhoods often walk a long way to reach their classrooms.
The clinic stands on a quiet street beside a bakery and a small park.
Small libraries in the valley were built of local stone a century ago.
Many rural districts elected new board members in the autumn vote.
The state flag shows a bear walking under a single red star.
Underfunded or not, the college won the regional debating trophy twice.
The county fair drew large crowds despite two days of rain.
